_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Technical Directive
summary: Provides the authority and instructions to accomplish and record a material change, repositioning, modification, alteration, or inspection of equipment or software.
use_relationship:
The Technical Directive (TD) provides the authority and instructions to accomplish and record a material change, repositioning, modification, an alteration, or inspection of the equipment or software to which it applies.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data described by the current version of NAVAIR SOP 00-25-300.

This DID applies to aircraft, weapons, equipment, support equipment, trainers, training devices, and companion software items.  This DID does not apply to intelligence processing equipment.

This DID contains the format, content and preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This DID supersedes DI-SESS-81269C.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The TD shall be prepared in accordance with the format prescribed in Appendices A through G of the current version of NAVAIR SOP 00-25-300.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: TDs shall contain instructions and information which direct the accomplishment and recording of a material change, repositioning, modification, or alternation in the characteristics of the equipment to which it applies.  A TD shall be used to direct that parts or material be added, removed, altered, relocated, or changed from the existing configuration.  Content requirements shall be as specified in the current version of NAVAIR SOP 00-25-300.
